selection: Rank the 72 intervention images by the smaller of the two models' whole-image correlations with positive local brightness; visually inspect the top eight. Select morimoto_0064 (third ranked; visibly glossy curved surface) for legible highlight/response comparison. This is an illustrative selection, not a population estimate or highlight-segmentation test.
maps: Unmodified token projections, per-model full-image min/max; full-frame overlay alpha .45, nearest-neighbor grid. Insets use the same ROI and color limits as the full frame.
dose: a times reference_scale times candidate direction, added to every TEST image bridge token only
outcome: Softmax normalized over A/B/SAME; test-glossier probability plus half SAME. Report changes in percentage points, not relative percentages.
scope: 72 images; 36 shapes; 2 viewpoints; illumination 1; both test/reference orders. Intervals are shape-cluster 95% bootstrap CIs.
